title: D3 Rest guide-related cross-half diagnostic
scope: D3 Rest only; no Stim expression, no new state, no gating model

selection.split: 20 within-lane pairs if available; otherwise minimally necessary cross-lane singleton pairs
selection.original_control_reuse_note: No control mean is subtracted; fixed keep and scale are conditioned upon.

primary.equivalence: mean over all unordered guide pairs of inner product of half-A guide difference and half-B guide difference, divided by 13390

uncertainty.bootstrap_unit: guide with both half spectra together
uncertainty.bootstrap_interval: 2.5% and 97.5% percentile; conditional guide-resampling interval, no donor/feature-axis/normalization uncertainty
uncertainty.p_values: upper one-sided primary plus absolute two-sided descriptive; plus-one correction
uncertainty.exchangeability: not a lane-adjusted or causal test

target_control.selection: original A15 441 eligible same-target guide pairs; choose first64 by sha256(new fixed salt+target)
target_control.cells: 40 per guide as two disjoint20-cell halves, same splitting rule as NTC
target_control.statistic: mean within-target guide difference cross-half inner product /13390
target_control.bootstrap_unit: target containing both guides and halves

composition: report NTChalf and target-guidehalf lane total variation, within-target between-guide lane variation, selectedNTC guide-by-lane Cramers V; no causal confounding removal claim
acquisition: 8 HTTP threads, exact byte ranges for selected rows, source identity checked, rowUMI verified,256-row atomic checkpoints
result_policy: report any sign/result; positive guide-associated repeatability and negative/nonsignificant nondetection; no new tuning
